title: Hat Kid Sprite for RPG Maker MV/MZ?

posts.author: CrossoverMedia
posts.body:
I understand if this is a big ask, as I've definitely done a lot of searching for this, and even made my own attempts at one of her sprites, but, in case there are any "A Hat in Time" fans here along with me, would there be a chance that someone has a sprite or a way of making a Hat Kid sprite for RPG Maker MV or MZ? (I tried generating a sprite in MZ, but I figured to ask for MV as well.) And for battle sprites, has any planned on using Hat Kid's sprites from "Fraymakers" for her sideview battle sprites? I just thought I'd try asking, but thanks to anyone in advanced!
